# Abbacy Global Group: study abroad and overseas education consultancy, Hyderabad

> Abbacy Global Group is a study abroad (overseas education) consultancy in Himayatnagar, Hyderabad, founded in 2019. It has helped 10,000+ students go abroad and reports a 99% visa approval rate on applications filed for its enrolled clients. Counselling is free; English test coaching (IELTS, PTE, TOEFL, Duolingo) is the only paid service. Main destinations: USA, UK, Canada, Australia, Germany, Ireland, France, the Netherlands and Dubai.

Last updated: 31 October 2026. Visa rules and fees on the linked pages are checked against official sources (gov.uk, travel.state.gov, IRCC, Home Affairs, DAAD and others), and each page shows its own check date. When a figure here and on a page differ, the page is newer.

## Key facts
- **Name**: Abbacy Global Group
- **Address**: 302-A, 3rd Floor, Aaltos A&M Trade Centre, Himayatnagar, Hyderabad, Telangana 500029, India (near Narayanaguda Metro)
- **Phone**: +91 83097 13212 (primary, also WhatsApp) · +91 78932 34081 · +91 83416 51082
- **Email**: info@abbacy.in
- **Website**: https://abbacy.in
- **Hours**: Monday to Saturday 9:00 AM to 7:30 PM; Sunday 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM (IST)
- **Founded**: 2019
- **Students helped**: 10,000+
- **Visa approval rate**: 99%, counted only on applications filed for enrolled clients
- **Google rating**: 4.9 from 217+ reviews
- **Fees**: counselling, university shortlisting, applications and visa guidance are free; English test coaching is paid
- **Counsellors**: Alisha Budhani (Senior Manager; USA and UK admissions, visa mock interviews; quoted in The Times of India on student visa trends), Laxmi (Senior Counsellor; UK, Canada and Australia visas), Gopi (Senior Counsellor; Germany and Europe, APS, blocked accounts, education loan documents)

## Services
- Free counselling and profile check, in person in Himayatnagar or by video call
- University and course shortlisting (dream, target and safe options)
- Applications, SOP and LOR review
- Student visa documents, funds checks and mock visa interviews (US F-1, UK, Canada, Australia, Germany and more)
- Help applying for education loans (collateral-free loans up to ₹50 lakh, secured loans above that) and scholarships, including Telangana overseas scholarship schemes
- English test coaching: IELTS, PTE, TOEFL and Duolingo (paid)
- Pre-departure and accommodation guidance

## What Abbacy does not do
- No visa or admission guarantees (no one can promise a visa decision)
- No MBBS abroad admissions
- Abbacy holds no ICEF or other agent certifications and does not claim to be an "official partner" of any university

Each section below is copied from the page itself: its summary and its questions and answers.

### Study Abroad & Overseas Consultancy in Hyderabad | Abbacy
URL: https://abbacy.in/ · Updated: 2026-10-23

Study abroad consultants in Hyderabad (Himayatnagar): ₹0 counselling, applications and visa filing for UK, USA, Canada, Australia. 4.9★, 217+ Google reviews.

**Q: Is Abbacy's study abroad counselling really free?**
A: Yes. Profile assessment, university shortlisting, SOP and LOR editing, application filing, scholarship and education loan assistance, visa filing and mock interviews all cost ₹0. Our partner universities fund our work. Only optional test coaching (IELTS, PTE, Duolingo, GRE) is paid, and visa, test and university fees are paid directly to the official portals.

**Q: How do I choose the best study abroad consultants in Hyderabad?**
A: Choose a consultancy that is open about fees, gives you one named counsellor and has reviews you can verify. Abbacy Global Group in Himayatnagar has offered free counselling since 2019, has placed 10,000+ students, holds a 4.9★ rating from 217+ Google reviews and reports a 99% visa approval rate on applications filed for enrolled clients.

**Q: How much does it cost to study abroad from India?**
A: Approximate yearly tuition: USA ₹15–38 lakh, UK ₹13–28 lakh (1-year Master's), Canada ₹11–24 lakh, Australia ₹15–29 lakh, Ireland ₹12–22 lakh and Dubai ₹9–18 lakh. Most German public universities charge €0 tuition. Add living costs and proof of funds. Use our cost and loan calculator for an estimate.

**Q: Can I study abroad without IELTS?**
A: Yes. Many universities in the UK, Dubai and Europe accept a Medium of Instruction (MOI) letter from your college, a strong Class 12 English score, the Duolingo English Test or their own English test. See UK without IELTS and Dubai without IELTS.

**Q: Can I get an education loan without collateral?**
A: Yes. Partner lenders such as HDFC Credila, Axis Bank and ICICI Bank offer unsecured education loans up to ₹50 lakh, depending on your profile and university. Secured loans of ₹1 crore or more are available through banks like SBI and Union Bank. We help with documents and sanction letters for free. See our education loan guide.

**Q: How can Telangana students get the ₹20 lakh overseas scholarship?**
A: Eligible students apply on the Telangana ePASS portal for the Ambedkar Overseas Vidya Nidhi (SC/ST) or the Mahatma Jyotiba Phule BC Overseas Vidya Nidhi (BC/EBC). These schemes offer up to ₹20 lakh plus airfare. We check your eligibility and prepare the application for free. Read the scholarships guide.

**Q: Can I study abroad with backlogs or a study gap?**
A: Usually, yes. Many universities accept students with backlogs, and a study gap can be explained with work experience, certifications or exam preparation. Your options depend on the number of backlogs and the country. Try the 2-minute eligibility check or read about studying in the UK after a gap.

**Q: How long does the study abroad process take?**
A: Most students go from first counselling to visa in 8–10 weeks once documents and test scores are ready. We recommend starting 6–9 months before your intake so you don't miss early deadlines and scholarships.

**Q: Do you offer IELTS, PTE and GRE coaching in Hyderabad?**
A: Yes, at our Himayatnagar centre. IELTS coaching is ₹5,000 (4 weeks), PTE ₹6,500–₹8,500 (3 weeks), Duolingo ₹4,500–₹6,000 (2 weeks) and GRE ₹12,000–₹16,000 (6 weeks). If you qualify for an English waiver, you may not need a test at all.

**Q: Do you help students from outside Hyderabad?**
A: Yes. Students from Warangal, Karimnagar, Nizamabad, Khammam, Nalgonda, Mahbubnagar and other districts usually start with a free video call and visit our Himayatnagar office once for document checks and a mock visa interview. See counselling for Telangana districts.

**Q: Where is Abbacy's office and what are the timings?**
A: 302-A, 3rd Floor, Aalto's A&M Trade Centre (above Subway), Himayatnagar Main Road, Hyderabad 500029. We're open Monday to Saturday 9:00 AM – 7:30 PM and Sunday 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM. Call or WhatsApp +91 83097 13212.

### Check Study Abroad & Visa Eligibility | Abbacy Global
URL: https://abbacy.in/eligibility.html · Updated: 2026-10-23

Check your study abroad eligibility in 2 minutes. Answer four questions about your marks, country, budget and English test for a free personalised roadmap.

**Q: Can I study abroad with academic backlogs from Hyderabad?**
A: Yes. Many universities in the USA, UK, and Europe accept students with up to 10–15 historical backlogs provided all backlogs are cleared at the time of visa application and you maintain a competitive aggregate percentage (55%–65%+). Abbacy Global has placed hundreds of students with backlogs from JNTUH and Osmania University.

**Q: What minimum percentage is required to study Master's abroad?**
A: For USA and UK, 55% to 65% aggregate is accepted by numerous accredited universities. For German public universities with €0 tuition, a minimum of 65% to 70%+ (or 7.0 CGPA) is generally required. Abbacy Global converts your Indian GPA to international scales to identify your best-fit universities.

**Q: Can I study abroad without IELTS or GRE?**
A: Yes. Top institutions in the UK, USA, France, and Dubai accept Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificates from Indian universities or Duolingo English Test (DET) scores. Over 150 US universities waive the GRE for engineering and computer science programs.

**Q: How do I check if I qualify for the Telangana ₹20 Lakh overseas scholarship?**
A: Eligible candidates must have family annual income below ₹5,00,000, valid admission to recognized universities in USA, UK, Australia, Canada, Germany, France, or Singapore, and minimum 60% in degree. Abbacy Global provides free verification for Ambedkar (SC/ST) and Mahatma Jyothiba Phule (BC/EBC) overseas schemes.

**Q: Is the eligibility assessment at Abbacy Global free?**
A: Yes. The online eligibility check and one-to-one counselling at our Himayatnagar office are free, with no hidden charges. Call +91 83097 13212 to talk through your results.

### USA Education Consultants in Hyderabad | Study in USA
URL: https://abbacy.in/study-in-usa.html · Updated: 2026-10-21

Study in USA from Hyderabad with Abbacy Global. 99% F-1 visa approval (enrolled clients), mock interviews, STEM OPT, I-20 help & free counselling.

**Q: Is the GRE required for an MS in the USA?**
A: Not always. Many US universities have made the GRE optional for master's admissions, but competitive programmes and some scholarships still ask for it. We tell you exactly which universities on your list need it.

**Q: How much bank balance do I need for an F-1 visa?**
A: You need liquid funds or a sanctioned education loan covering at least the first year's cost of attendance shown on your I-20, which is often ₹35–45 lakh for a master's. Funds should be in your or your sponsor's name with a clear source.

**Q: Can I work part-time in the USA as a student?**
A: F-1 students can usually work on campus for up to 20 hours a week during term. Off-campus work is only allowed through CPT or OPT linked to your course, so you should not plan to fund your studies through part-time work.

**Q: When should I apply for the Fall 2027 intake?**
A: Start your shortlist and tests between July and September 2026. Most Fall application deadlines fall between December 2026 and February 2027, and early applications have a better chance of scholarships.

**Q: Does Abbacy help with the F-1 visa interview?**
A: Yes. We run daily 1-on-1 mock F-1 interviews at our Himayatnagar office and check that your DS-160, I-20 and financial documents are consistent, free of charge.

### Canada Education Consultants in Hyderabad | Study in Canada
URL: https://abbacy.in/study-in-canada.html · Updated: 2026-10-20

Study in Canada from Hyderabad: PAL rules, GIC proof of funds, study permit filing and up to 3 years of PGWP after a master's. Free counselling.

**Q: Is the Student Direct Stream (SDS) still available for Canada?**
A: No. IRCC closed the Student Direct Stream on 8 November 2024. Indian students now apply through the regular study permit process with a PAL, proof of funds and an accepted English test score.

**Q: How much is the GIC for Canada?**
A: IRCC requires proof of CAD 23,448 for living costs (for applications from 1 September 2026), usually shown through a Guaranteed Investment Certificate, plus your first-year tuition and travel costs.

**Q: Do master's students need a PAL?**
A: Yes. Since January 2025 most master's and PhD students also need a Provincial Attestation Letter, which your institution helps you obtain after you accept your offer.

**Q: How long is the PGWP after a master's?**
A: Graduates of master's programmes can usually get a PGWP of up to 3 years, even if the programme is shorter than 2 years. College programmes give a PGWP equal to their length, up to 3 years, if the field is eligible.

**Q: Can I work while studying in Canada?**
A: Yes. Students can usually work up to 24 hours a week off campus during academic sessions and full-time during scheduled breaks.

### Australia Education Consultants in Hyderabad | Abbacy
URL: https://abbacy.in/study-in-australia.html · Updated: 2026-10-20

Australia education consultants in Hyderabad: free counselling at Abbacy, Himayatnagar. Go8 and regional shortlists, Genuine Student statement, visa filing.

**Q: How long can I work in Australia after a master's?**
A: Under the Australia–India Economic Cooperation and Trade Agreement, Indian master's graduates can usually get 3 years on the subclass 485 visa, bachelor's graduates 2 years and PhD graduates 4 years. Studying in a regional area can add more.

**Q: How much money do I need to show for an Australian student visa?**
A: You must show living costs of AUD 29,710 a year plus tuition and travel, or meet the alternative annual income test.

**Q: Is IELTS required for Australia?**
A: An English test is required for the visa and admission. IELTS, PTE Academic and TOEFL are widely accepted; PTE is popular for its fast results.

**Q: When are the Australian intakes?**
A: The main intakes are February and July, and some universities also start in November. Apply 6–8 months ahead.

**Q: Can I work while studying in Australia?**
A: Yes. Student visa holders can work up to 48 hours per fortnight during study periods and unlimited hours during scheduled breaks.

### UK Education Consultants in Hyderabad | Study in UK
URL: https://abbacy.in/study-in-uk.html · Updated: 2026-10-20

UK education consultants in Hyderabad: 1-year master's, IELTS waivers, up to £5,000 scholarships, CAS and visa guidance, and the Graduate Route.

**Q: Can I study in the UK without IELTS?**
A: Yes. Many UK universities accept 70% or more in Class 12 English (CBSE, ICSE or TSBIE) or an MOI letter from your college instead. If the university assesses your English itself, you do not need a separate UKVI English test. See universities that waive IELTS.

**Q: How much bank balance do I need for a UK student visa?**
A: Your unpaid first-year tuition plus living costs of £1,171 a month outside London or £1,529 in London, for up to 9 months, held for 28 consecutive days. A sanctioned education loan letter can be used instead of savings.

**Q: Is the UK Graduate Route still 2 years?**
A: For applications made before 1 January 2027 it is 2 years. For applications from 1 January 2027 it is 18 months for bachelor's and master's graduates. PhD graduates still get 3 years.

**Q: When are the UK intakes?**
A: The main intakes are September and January, and some universities also start courses in May. Apply 6–9 months ahead for the best choice of courses and scholarships.

**Q: Which UK universities accept students with backlogs?**
A: Many UK universities accept students with a few cleared backlogs, especially post-1992 universities. Requirements differ by course, so we check each university on your list against your transcripts.

### Germany Education Consultants in Hyderabad | Study in Germany
URL: https://abbacy.in/study-in-germany.html · Updated: 2026-10-20

Study at tuition-free public German universities from Hyderabad. Complete APS India certificate guidance, blocked account setup & 18-month stay-back visa.

**Q: Is studying in Germany really free?**
A: At most public universities, yes: there are no tuition fees, only a semester contribution of about €150–€350. Baden-Württemberg charges non-EU students €1,500 a semester, and private universities charge full tuition.

**Q: What is the APS certificate?**
A: The APS certificate is issued by the Academic Evaluation Centre in India after verifying your academic documents. It is mandatory for Indian students applying to German universities and for the student visa.

**Q: How much is the blocked account for Germany?**
A: Students must show €11,904 a year (€992 a month) in a blocked account as proof of living funds, unless they have a scholarship such as DAAD.

**Q: Do I need to know German?**
A: Not for English-taught programmes, which accept IELTS or TOEFL. Learning basic German (A1–B1) is strongly recommended for part-time jobs, internships and life outside campus.

**Q: Can I work after graduating in Germany?**
A: Yes. Graduates can get a residence permit of up to 18 months to look for work, and then move to an EU Blue Card or work permit once they find a qualifying job.

### France Education Consultants in Hyderabad | Study in France
URL: https://abbacy.in/study-in-france.html · Updated: 2026-10-20

Study in France from Hyderabad: public university fees of €2,770–€3,770 a year, Grandes Écoles, CAF housing aid and a 5-year Schengen visa for Indian alumni.

**Q: How much are tuition fees in France for Indian students?**
A: At most public universities non-EU students pay €2,770 a year for a bachelor's and €3,770 a year for a master's. Grandes Écoles and business schools charge more, often €12,000–€40,000 a year.

**Q: What is the 5-year Schengen visa for Indian master's graduates from France?**
A: Indian students who complete at least a master's degree in France can apply for a 5-year short-stay Schengen visa, which allows repeat visits to France and the Schengen area. It is not a work permit.

**Q: Do I need to speak French?**
A: Not for English-taught programmes, but basic French helps with part-time jobs, internships and daily life.

**Q: What is CAF?**
A: CAF is the French family benefits office. International students renting accommodation can apply for housing aid (APL or ALS) that reduces their monthly rent.

**Q: What is the Campus France interview?**
A: It is a short interview with Campus France India that checks your study plan, choice of programme and readiness before your visa application.

### Dubai Education Consultants in Hyderabad | Study in Dubai
URL: https://abbacy.in/study-in-dubai.html · Updated: 2026-10-20

Study in Dubai from Hyderabad: UK and Australian branch campuses, fees in INR, IELTS waivers, a university-sponsored student visa and tax-free careers.

**Q: Can I study in Dubai without IELTS?**
A: Yes. Many Dubai campuses accept an MOI letter from your college, Class 12 English marks of around 65–70% or more, or their own English test. See how each route works.

**Q: Is a Dubai branch campus degree the same as the UK degree?**
A: Yes. Branch campuses of UK and Australian universities award the same degree as the home campus, with the same name on the certificate.

**Q: How much does it cost to study in Dubai?**
A: Tuition is typically ₹9–18 lakh a year depending on the university and course, and living costs are about ₹55,000–₹70,000 a month including shared accommodation.

**Q: Can I move from Dubai to the UK or Australia mid-degree?**
A: Yes, many universities offer 1+1 or 2+1 transfer routes to their home campus. Read about transfer pathways.

**Q: Is there an interview for the UAE student visa?**
A: No. Your university sponsors your visa, so there is no embassy interview.

### Ireland Education Consultants in Hyderabad | Study in Ireland
URL: https://abbacy.in/study-in-ireland.html · Updated: 2026-10-20

Study in Ireland from Hyderabad: 1-year master's in computer science, data and AI, a 2-year Stamp 1G stay-back visa and Dublin's tech job market.

**Q: How long is the stay-back visa in Ireland?**
A: Graduates of a level 9 master's can get up to 2 years on Stamp 1G under the Third Level Graduate Programme. Level 8 graduates get up to 1 year.

**Q: Is IELTS required for Ireland?**
A: Most universities ask for IELTS 6.5 or equivalent, but some accept an MOI letter or other English tests. We check each university on your list.

**Q: How much bank balance is needed for an Irish student visa?**
A: You must show that your tuition is paid or covered and that you have access to at least €10,000 a year for living costs.

**Q: What jobs can I get in Ireland after a master's?**
A: Graduates commonly work in software, data, cloud, pharma, medical devices and finance, especially in Dublin, Cork and Galway.

**Q: When are the Ireland intakes?**
A: The main intake is September, with some programmes starting in January.

### Study in the Netherlands: Education Consultants in Hyderabad
URL: https://abbacy.in/study-in-netherlands.html · Updated: 2026-10-20

Study in the Netherlands from Hyderabad: English-taught master's at TU Delft, Amsterdam and Eindhoven, the 1-year orientation year and Holland Scholarship.

**Q: What is the zoekjaar visa?**
A: The zoekjaar (orientation year) is a residence permit that lets graduates of Dutch universities stay for up to one year to look for work or start a business, without needing an employer sponsor.

**Q: How much does a master's in the Netherlands cost?**
A: Non-EU students usually pay €16,000–€25,000 a year in tuition, plus living costs as set by the IND each year.

**Q: What is the Holland Scholarship?**
A: It is a one-time €5,000 grant for non-EEA students in their first year at participating Dutch universities.

**Q: Is IELTS required for the Netherlands?**
A: Yes, most universities ask for IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL. Some accept an MOI letter for certain programmes.

**Q: When should I apply?**
A: Apply 8–10 months ahead. Many September programmes close between 1 February and 1 May.

### Study Abroad Scholarships 2026 for Indian Students | Abbacy
URL: https://abbacy.in/guide-scholarships.html · Updated: 2026-10-20

Explore global study abroad scholarships for Indian students. Telangana ₹20L ePASS grants, university merit aid & application support at Himayatnagar.

**Q: How can Telangana students get the ₹20 lakh overseas scholarship?**
A: Eligible students apply on the Telangana ePASS portal for the Ambedkar Overseas Vidya Nidhi (SC/ST) or the Mahatma Jyotiba Phule BC Overseas Vidya Nidhi (BC/EBC). These offer up to ₹20 lakh plus airfare, subject to income and academic conditions.

**Q: Is DAAD fully funded?**
A: Yes. DAAD master's scholarships pay a monthly stipend of about €934, health insurance and a travel allowance, and German public universities charge no tuition.

**Q: Can I get a scholarship with average marks?**
A: Yes. Many universities give automatic awards at moderate grade levels, and some Dubai and UK campuses offer awards from around 60%.

**Q: When should I apply for scholarships?**
A: Start 9–12 months before your intake. DAAD and Chevening applications usually close about 10 months ahead.

**Q: Does Abbacy help with scholarship applications?**
A: Yes. We identify every scholarship you qualify for and help with essays and documents, free of charge.

A: Yes. Students from Mahbubnagar, Jadcherla, Shadnagar, Wanaparthy and other districts visit us, often at weekends, and we offer online counselling for anyone who cannot travel.

### MS in USA Cost for Indian Students (2026–27) | Abbacy
URL: https://abbacy.in/guide-usa.html · Updated: 2026-10-20

MS in USA cost for Indian students in 2026–27: tuition, living costs, I-20 funds, OPT and the 2026 F-1 rule changes. Free counselling in Hyderabad.

**Q: How much does an MS in the USA cost in rupees?**
A: A 2-year MS usually costs ₹42–105 lakh in total, depending on the university and city. Public universities in lower-cost cities are at the bottom of that range.

**Q: What is the cheapest way to study in the USA?**
A: Choose public universities in lower-cost states, apply early for merit scholarships, and target departments that offer assistantships.

**Q: How much bank balance is needed for the F-1 visa?**
A: Enough liquid funds or a sanctioned loan to cover the first-year cost of attendance printed on your I-20, with a clear plan for later years.

**Q: Can I work part-time to pay my fees?**
A: Only on campus, up to 20 hours a week during term. It helps with living costs but should not be counted as your main funding.

**Q: What is the new fixed period of admission for F-1 students?**
A: A final rule effective 15 September 2026 admits F-1 students for the programme length on their I-20, up to 4 years, plus 30 days to arrive and 30 days to depart. Extensions, new programmes and OPT may need an extension of stay from USCIS.

**Q: Is OPT going to cost $70,000 per student?**
A: No. DHS published a proposed rule on 8 October 2026 that would charge $70,000 for initial OPT and $30,000 for later OPT per F-1 student recommended. It is only a proposal, DHS may revise it after comments, and it is not in effect.

**Q: How long can I work after an MS in the USA?**
A: F-1 students can get 12 months of OPT, plus a 24-month STEM OPT extension for eligible STEM degrees, so up to 36 months in total for STEM graduates.

Education loans for abroad studies from Hyderabad: collateral-free loans up to ₹50 lakh, secured loans, documents, EMI and free help with sanction letters.

### IELTS vs PTE vs TOEFL vs Duolingo (2026): Which to Take
URL: https://abbacy.in/guide-ielts.html · Updated: 2026-10-20

IELTS vs PTE vs TOEFL vs Duolingo in 2026: the new TOEFL format, which countries accept which test, score conversion and how to choose. Free advice.

**Q: Which is easier, IELTS or PTE?**
A: It depends on you. PTE is computer-scored and quick, which suits confident typists; IELTS uses a human examiner for speaking, which some students prefer.

**Q: What changed in the TOEFL iBT in 2026?**
A: ETS launched the updated TOEFL iBT on 21 January 2026. Scores are now reported on a 1–6 scale in half-point steps, Reading and Listening are adaptive, the test takes about two hours, and scores arrive within 72 hours or less. Until January 2028 ETS also provides a comparable 0–120 estimate.

**Q: Which English test do I need for a UK student visa?**
A: Degree-level courses need English at CEFR B2. You can prove it with a Secure English Language Test (SELT) from an approved provider, or your university may assess your English itself, and that assessment must still equal B2. Some applicants are exempt.

**Q: Is the Duolingo English Test accepted in the UK or Australia?**
A: Some universities accept it for admission, but it is not a Secure English Language Test for UK visas, and it is not on the Australian Home Affairs list we checked. Confirm with each university and the official visa page.

**Q: How long are English test scores valid?**
A: IELTS, PTE, Duolingo and TOEFL scores are generally valid for 2 years.

**Q: Can I study abroad without any English test?**
A: Often you can use another proof. Some UK and Dubai universities accept strong Class 12 English marks or an MOI letter. See UK IELTS waivers, Canada without IELTS and Australia without IELTS in our guides.

**Q: Do you offer coaching for all these tests?**
A: Yes. We coach IELTS, PTE, Duolingo and GRE at our Himayatnagar centre and online.

### UK Student Visa: 28-Day Bank Balance Rule | Abbacy Global
URL: https://abbacy.in/uk-student-visa-financial-proof-28-day-rule.html · Updated: 2026-10-20

UK student visa financial proof explained: the 28-day bank balance rule, UKVI living costs (£1,171 or £1,529 a month), approved banks and loan letters.

**Q: What is the 28-day rule for a UK student visa?**
A: You must hold the required funds in an acceptable account for at least 28 consecutive days, ending no more than 31 days before you apply.

**Q: How much money do I need for a UK student visa?**
A: Your unpaid first-year tuition plus £1,171 a month outside London or £1,529 in London, for up to 9 months.

**Q: Can I use my parents' bank account?**
A: Yes, with a letter of consent from your parents and proof of your relationship, such as a birth certificate.

**Q: Is an education loan accepted as proof of funds?**
A: Yes. A loan sanction letter from a regulated lender is accepted, as long as it meets UKVI's requirements.

**Q: What happens if my balance drops for one day?**
A: The 28-day period restarts from the next day the full amount is in the account.

A: Yes, once you complete your course.

**Q: Which courses have January starts?**
A: Mostly business, computing, data, engineering and health master's; check each university.

### F-1 Visa Interview Questions & Answers (Hyderabad) | Abbacy
URL: https://abbacy.in/f1-visa-interview-questions-hyderabad.html · Updated: 2026-10-21

Common F-1 visa interview questions with sample answers, documents to carry and tips for the US Consulate in Hyderabad. Free mock interviews in Himayatnagar.

**Q: How long is an F-1 visa interview at the Hyderabad consulate?**
A: The conversation with the officer usually lasts two to three minutes, though you may spend a few hours at the consulate including security and queueing. Because the interview is so short, your first two or three answers make the biggest impression.

**Q: What is a 214(b) refusal?**
A: Section 214(b) of the US Immigration and Nationality Act presumes every visa applicant intends to immigrate. A 214(b) refusal means the officer was not convinced that you are a genuine student, that you can pay for your studies, or that you will follow your visa terms. It is not a permanent ban, and you can reapply.

**Q: Can I study in the USA with backlogs?**
A: Yes. Many US universities admit students with a few cleared backlogs, and officers do not refuse visas for backlogs alone. Be honest about them in your interview and point to evidence of your current ability, such as your final-year marks, projects or test scores.

**Q: Should I mention OPT in my F-1 interview?**
A: You can. OPT is a legal part of the F-1 programme that lets you gain work experience after your degree. Describe it as practical training that supports your longer-term career plans, and be honest about what you intend to do.

**Q: Does Abbacy offer F-1 mock interviews in Hyderabad?**
A: Yes. Abbacy Global Group runs daily 1-on-1 mock F-1 interviews at its Himayatnagar office for students it guides, and checks that your DS-160, I-20 and financial documents are consistent. Counselling and mock interviews are free.

### MS in Canada Cost for Indian Students | Tuition, GIC & PGWP
URL: https://abbacy.in/ms-in-canada-cost-for-indian-students.html · Updated: 2026-10-21

What an MS in Canada costs for Indian students: tuition by institution type, CAD 23,448 proof of funds, loans up to ₹50 lakh and up to 3 years of PGWP.

**Q: How much does an MS in Canada cost for Indian students?**
A: Tuition usually runs ₹9–35 lakh a year depending on the type of institution. On top of that, your study permit needs proof of CAD 23,448 for living costs (usually a GIC) plus first-year tuition and travel costs.

**Q: Which type of Canadian institution is the cheapest?**
A: Colleges and polytechnics are the lowest at roughly ₹9–14 lakh a year, but the programme must be on the eligible field-of-study list for a PGWP.

**Q: Can I get a loan without collateral for Canada?**
A: Yes. Collateral-free loans go up to ₹50 lakh from lenders such as HDFC Credila, Axis Bank and ICICI Bank, depending on the university and course. Higher amounts usually need property or a fixed deposit as collateral.

**Q: Can I work during my master's in Canada?**
A: Yes. Students can usually work up to 24 hours a week off campus during academic sessions and full-time during scheduled breaks.

### Master's in Australia Cost for Indian Students | Fees & Funds
URL: https://abbacy.in/masters-in-australia-cost-for-indian-students.html · Updated: 2026-10-21

What a master's in Australia costs for Indian students: AUD 30,000–50,000 tuition, AUD 29,710 living-cost proof, visa fee, OSHC and post-study work.

**Q: How much does a master's in Australia cost for Indian students?**
A: Tuition is usually AUD 30,000–50,000 a year, about ₹15–29 lakh. You also need to show living costs of AUD 29,710 a year, pay the AUD 2,500 visa fee and buy OSHC health cover of about AUD 600–900 a year.

**Q: Are there scholarships for Indian students in Australia?**
A: Many universities offer automatic merit scholarships of 10–30% for Indian students with good marks. Value and eligibility depend on the university and course.

**Q: Can I work while studying in Australia?**
A: Yes. Students can usually work up to 48 hours a fortnight during study periods.

**Q: How long can I stay and work after a master's in Australia?**
A: Under the Australia–India trade agreement, Indian graduates can usually get 3 years of post-study work after a master's on the subclass 485 visa, with extra time possible for regional study.

### MS in Germany Cost & Blocked Account Amount (2026)
URL: https://abbacy.in/ms-in-germany-cost-and-blocked-account.html · Updated: 2026-10-23

MS in Germany cost for Indian students: €0 tuition at most public universities, the €11,904 blocked account (€992 a month), semester fees and private options.

**Q: How much does an MS in Germany cost for Indian students?**
A: At most public universities tuition is €0 and you pay a semester contribution of about €150–€350. You also need a blocked account of €11,904 a year (€992 a month) for your visa and public student health insurance once enrolled.

**Q: How much is the blocked account for Germany?**
A: The blocked account requirement is €11,904 a year, which is €992 a month.

**Q: How much do private universities in Germany cost?**
A: Private universities charge about €10,000–€20,000 a year, with more flexible admission and faster decisions than public universities.

**Q: Can I work after my master's in Germany?**
A: Yes. Graduates can stay for up to 18 months to look for work, then move to an EU Blue Card.

A neutral checklist for choosing an overseas education consultant in Hyderabad: fees, guarantees, counsellors, reviews, shortlists, loans and visa preparation.

**Q: Can a consultant guarantee a visa?**
A: No. Visa decisions are made by immigration authorities. A consultant can prepare your documents and interview, but anyone promising a guaranteed visa should be avoided.

### MS in France Cost for Indian Students | Fees & Visa Funds
URL: https://abbacy.in/ms-in-france-cost-for-indian-students.html · Updated: 2026-10-22

MS in France cost for Indian students: public university fee of €3,950 a year (2026–27), €877.50 monthly visa funds from August 2026, private schools and loans.

**Q: How much does an MS in France cost for Indian students?**
A: A master's at a French public university costs non-EU students €3,950 a year in 2026–27. Private and business schools usually charge about €6,000–18,000 or more a year, so the total depends heavily on the type of school.

**Q: Is France cheaper than Germany or the UK?**
A: Public universities in France charge a fixed €3,950 a year for a master's, which is far lower than most UK master's fees. Germany's public universities charge little or no tuition, so Germany is usually the lower-cost option on fees alone.

**Q: How much money do I need to show for a French student visa?**
A: Since 1 August 2026 the minimum is €877.50 per month, up from €615. Confirm with your consulate how many months of funds you need to show.

**Q: Can I get an education loan for France?**
A: Yes. Collateral-free loans go up to ₹50 lakh from partner lenders, depending on the school and course. Higher amounts usually need property or a fixed deposit as collateral.

**Q: Can I work while studying in France?**
A: Students on a French student permit can generally work part-time within a yearly hour limit of about 964 hours. Check the exact conditions on your own permit.

### MS in Ireland Cost for Indian Students | Fees & Funds
URL: https://abbacy.in/ms-in-ireland-cost-for-indian-students.html · Updated: 2026-10-22

MS in Ireland cost for Indian students: €9,000–30,000 tuition, €10,000 visa funds, 20-hour work limit and up to 24 months of Stamp 1G after a master's.

**Q: How much does an MS in Ireland cost for Indian students?**
A: Non-EU taught master's fees run from about €9,000 to €30,000 a year, depending on the university and programme. For example, the University of Limerick lists most 2026–27 taught master's courses at about €18,000–18,600.

**Q: How much money do I need to show for an Irish student visa?**
A: You must show access to €10,000 for each year of study for living costs, and you must pay at least €6,000 of your tuition before you apply if your fees are over €6,000.

**Q: Can I work while studying in Ireland?**
A: Students on Stamp 2 can generally work up to 20 hours a week in term time and up to 40 hours a week during holiday periods, if their course is on the Interim List of Eligible Programmes.

**Q: How long can I stay in Ireland after my master's?**
A: Graduates with a Level 9 award can get Stamp 1G for up to 24 months, granted as two 12-month blocks. The second block depends on showing you have looked for graduate-level work.

**Q: Can I get an education loan for Ireland?**
A: Yes. Collateral-free loans go up to ₹50 lakh from partner lenders, depending on the university and course. Higher amounts usually need property or a fixed deposit.

### MS in Netherlands Cost for Indian Students | Fees & Funds
URL: https://abbacy.in/ms-in-netherlands-cost-for-indian-students.html · Updated: 2026-10-22

MS in Netherlands cost for Indian students: €12,000–30,000 non-EU tuition, €1,130.77 monthly permit funds and a 1-year orientation year after graduating.

**Q: How much does an MS in the Netherlands cost for Indian students?**
A: Non-EU students pay the institutional fee, which for master's programmes averages about €12,000 to €30,000 a year according to Nuffic. Each university sets its own fee, so check the programme page.

**Q: How much money do I need to show for a Dutch student permit?**
A: For 2026 the IND requires €1,130.77 per month for university study, about €13,570 over 12 months.

**Q: Can I stay and work in the Netherlands after my master's?**
A: Graduates of Dutch programmes can apply for an orientation year permit that gives them one year to find work, and they can work freely during that year.

**Q: Is the Netherlands cheaper than the UK?**
A: Non-EU master's fees in the Netherlands (about €12,000–30,000) overlap with many UK fees, so the Netherlands is not automatically cheaper. Compare the programme fee, living costs and the length of the course.

**Q: What are living costs in the Netherlands?**
A: Study in Holland reports average student spending of about €1,000–1,500 a month, with housing from roughly €450 to €1,000. These estimates are older, so check current rents in your city.

### Post-Study Work Visa Comparison for Indian Students
URL: https://abbacy.in/post-study-work-visa-comparison-for-indian-students.html · Updated: 2026-10-22

Compare post-study work visas for Indian students: UK Graduate visa, Canada PGWP, USA OPT, Australia 485, Ireland Stamp 1G, Germany, Netherlands and France.

**Q: Which country gives the longest post-study work permit?**
A: After a master's, Canada's PGWP can run up to 3 years, and the USA allows 12 months of OPT plus a 24-month STEM extension for eligible degrees. Australia's 485 is usually 2–3 years for degree-level study.

**Q: How long is the UK Graduate visa?**
A: It is 2 years if you apply on or before 31 December 2026 and 18 months if you apply on or after 1 January 2027. PhD graduates get 3 years.

**Q: Do I need an English test for the Canadian PGWP?**
A: Most applicants since 1 November 2024 must show language results: CLB 7 for a university degree and CLB 5 for a college programme.

**Q: Can I work in Germany after my master's?**
A: Yes. Graduates can get a residence permit of up to 18 months to look for qualified work, and they can then switch to a skilled-worker permit or EU Blue Card.

**Q: Does a post-study work permit guarantee a job or PR?**
A: No. These permits give you time and permission to work, but you still need to find an employer, and permanent residence has separate rules in each country.

### Study in Canada Without IELTS (2026): What Works
URL: https://abbacy.in/study-in-canada-without-ielts.html · Updated: 2026-10-22

Study in Canada without IELTS: how universities accept MOI, Duolingo, PTE or TOEFL, why the study permit has no test, and the CLB 7 language rule for PGWP.

**Q: Is IELTS mandatory for a Canadian study permit?**
A: IRCC's study permit document list does not include an English test. The English requirement is set by the university or college that admits you, and many accept alternatives to IELTS.

**Q: Which tests can replace IELTS for Canadian universities?**
A: Many accept the Duolingo English Test, PTE Academic or TOEFL iBT, and some accept an MOI letter. Acceptance and minimum scores differ by university and programme, so check each programme page.

**Q: Do I need a language test for the PGWP if I skipped IELTS?**
A: Yes, most applicants since 1 November 2024 must show language results: CLB 7 for a university degree and CLB 5 for a college programme.

**Q: Is the Student Direct Stream still available?**
A: No. The Student Direct Stream ended in November 2024, and all applicants now use the regular study permit process.

**Q: How much money must I show for a Canadian study permit?**
A: For applications from 1 September 2026, IRCC asks for CAD 23,448 for living costs for one person, plus tuition and travel. Applications from 1 January 2025 to 31 August 2026 used CAD 22,895.

### US F-1 Rule Changes 2026: Fixed Stay & OPT Fees
URL: https://abbacy.in/usa-f1-rule-changes-2026-fixed-admission-and-opt-fee-proposal.html · Updated: 2026-10-22

Two 2026 US rules for F-1 students explained: the fixed period of admission (effective 15 Sept 2026) and the proposed OPT fees. What is final and what is not.

**Q: What is the fixed period of admission for F-1 students?**
A: A final rule effective 15 September 2026 admits F-1 students for the programme length on their I-20, up to four years, plus 30 days to arrive and 30 days to depart, instead of duration of status.

**Q: Do I need to extend my stay under the new rule?**
A: Students who need more time for their programme, a new programme, or post-completion OPT or STEM OPT must either apply to USCIS for an extension of stay or leave the US and obtain a new admission period on re-entry.

**Q: Is the $70,000 OPT fee in effect?**
A: No. It is a proposal published on 8 October 2026. DHS proposes $70,000 for initial OPT and $30,000 for later OPT per F-1 student, and it may revise the rule after public comments.

**Q: Does the new rule apply to students already in the USA?**
A: Students admitted under duration of status before 15 September 2026 can stay until the Program End Date on their I-20, or the end of any OPT or STEM OPT, not exceeding 14 November 2030.

**Q: Can I still apply for OPT and STEM OPT?**
A: Yes. OPT remains available under the current rules: up to 12 months after each education level, plus a 24-month STEM OPT extension for eligible STEM degrees. The fee is only a proposal.

### Study in Australia Without IELTS (2026): Real Options
URL: https://abbacy.in/study-in-australia-without-ielts.html · Updated: 2026-10-22

Study in Australia without IELTS: which other tests the visa accepts (PTE, TOEFL, C1 Advanced, OET), what is not accepted, and why you cannot combine scores.

**Q: Can I study in Australia without IELTS?**
A: Yes, if you use another test on the Home Affairs approved list, such as PTE Academic, TOEFL iBT, C1 Advanced, OET, MET, CELPIP General or LanguageCert Academic. You cannot skip English proof entirely for a student visa unless you qualify for an exemption.

**Q: Is PTE accepted for an Australian student visa?**
A: Yes. PTE Academic is on the Home Affairs list. The scoring changed for tests taken from 7 August 2025, so check the current score table before you book.

**Q: Is the Duolingo English Test accepted for the Australian student visa?**
A: It is not on the Home Affairs list we checked. Confirm with your university and the current Home Affairs page before you rely on it.

**Q: Can I combine scores from two different tests?**
A: No. Home Affairs has advised that results from multiple tests cannot be used together to meet the student visa English requirement.

**Q: Can I take IELTS or CELPIP online for an Australian visa?**
A: No. At-home online versions such as IELTS Online and CELPIP Online are not accepted for Australian visa purposes.

### Study in Germany Without IELTS (2026): Other Proofs
URL: https://abbacy.in/study-in-germany-without-ielts.html · Updated: 2026-10-22

Study in Germany without IELTS: DAAD-listed alternatives (TOEFL, PTE, Duolingo, C1 certificates), MOI proof, typical B2–C1 levels and the new TOEFL scale.

**Q: Can I study in Germany without IELTS?**
A: Yes. Each English-taught programme sets its own requirement, and DAAD lists examples such as Cambridge English, TOEFL iBT, PTE Academic and the Duolingo English Test as accepted proofs. Some programmes also accept an English-medium degree with an MOI certificate.

**Q: What English level do German master's programmes ask for?**
A: Sample DAAD listings range from B2 to C1, for example IELTS 5.5 at one Aachen programme and 6.5 at one Trier programme, with some arts and literature programmes asking for IELTS 7.

**Q: Does an MOI certificate replace IELTS in Germany?**
A: At some programmes, yes. One listing accepts at least 180 ECTS in an English-medium degree shown through an MOI certificate, but other programmes do not, so check each programme page.

**Q: How does the new TOEFL scale affect German applications?**
A: ETS launched a 1–6 scale on 21 January 2026. Some listings show separate cut-offs for scores since 2026 and before 2026, so compare your result with the matching one.

**Q: How much money must I show for a German student visa?**
A: Make it in Germany lists a minimum blocked-account balance of €11,904 for 2026, which is €992 per month for the first year.

### Study Abroad Intakes & Deadlines for 2027: Plan Now
URL: https://abbacy.in/study-abroad-intakes-and-deadlines-2027.html · Updated: 2026-10-22

Study abroad intakes and deadlines for 2027: UK, Canada, Australia, Germany and the USA, what you can still make from late October 2026, and a timeline.

**Q: Which intake should I target if I start now?**
A: For most students the September 2027 intake is the best target if you start in late October 2026. It leaves time for English tests, applications, offers, loans and the visa.

**Q: Can I still apply for a January 2027 intake?**
A: Only where your course is still open. Many UK and Canadian deadlines for January are close or passed, and study permits and visas take months, so confirm the deadline and the visa timeline first.

**Q: What are the German semester deadlines?**
A: Winter semester applications usually run from early May to 15 July, and summer semester from early December to 15 January. Many master's programmes close earlier, and uni-assist advises applying at least 8 weeks before the deadline.

**Q: What are Australia's intakes?**
A: Semester 1 starts in February or March and Semester 2 in July or August. Not every course has a mid-year intake, and each university sets its own deadlines.

**Q: How early should I start applying to the UK?**
A: UCAS suggests applying about six months before a postgraduate course starts, and some universities have earlier cut-offs for student-visa applicants, such as 18 June at Imperial.

### Student Visa Documents Checklist: UK, Canada, USA & More
URL: https://abbacy.in/student-visa-documents-checklist-by-country.html · Updated: 2026-10-22

Student visa documents checklist for Indian students: UK, Canada, Australia, Germany and USA, from official pages, with 2026 funds and fee figures.

**Q: What documents do I need for a UK student visa from India?**
A: A current passport and a CAS from your course provider are required. You also need financial evidence, a TB test certificate (India is on the list), an ATAS certificate if your course requires it, and parental consent if you are under 18.

**Q: How much money must I show for a UK student visa?**
A: GOV.UK asks for £1,529 a month for courses in London or £1,171 a month outside London, for up to 9 months, plus your first-year course fee. The money must be held for at least 28 consecutive days.

**Q: What documents are needed for a Canadian study permit?**
A: A letter of acceptance, a Provincial or Territorial Attestation Letter in most cases, proof of identity, proof of funds (CAD 23,448 for living costs from 1 September 2026, plus tuition and travel), and sometimes a medical exam and police certificate.

**Q: What do I need for a German student visa from India?**
A: The German Missions list a passport, previous degree or school certificates, language proof, an APS certificate, proof of admission, a statement of intent, a CV, a blocked account of €11,904 or another proof of funds, and health insurance.

**Q: What do I bring to an F-1 visa interview?**
A: Your original signed Form I-20, passport, DS-160 confirmation page, a photo, the visa fee receipt, the I-901 SEVIS fee receipt, and copies of the financial and academic documents you gave your university.

### Cheapest Countries to Study Abroad for Indian Students 2026
URL: https://abbacy.in/cheapest-countries-to-study-abroad-for-indian-students.html · Updated: 2026-10-22

Cheapest countries to study abroad for Indian students in 2026: official tuition and visa-funds figures for Germany, France, Ireland, UK, Canada and more.

**Q: Which country is cheapest to study in for Indian students?**
A: On published tuition, Germany is the lowest because most public universities charge no tuition, followed by France at €3,950 a year for a public master's in 2026–27. Total cost also depends on living costs, the city and the visa funds you must show.

**Q: Is Germany really tuition-free for Indian students?**
A: Most public universities charge no tuition for most bachelor's and master's programmes, but Baden-Württemberg charges non-EU students €1,500 per semester, some continuing-education master's programmes charge fees, and a semester contribution of €70–430 applies.

**Q: How much money must I show for the German visa?**
A: For 2026 the blocked account minimum is €11,904 for the first year, which is €992 a month.

**Q: Is the UK cheaper than Canada?**
A: Both are in a similar band. UCAS reports UK international postgraduate fees from £11,400 to £38,000, while Statistics Canada reports an average international graduate tuition of about CAD 24,028 in 2025/26. Compare specific programmes.

**Q: Do visa funds equal my total cost?**
A: No. The amount is a minimum you must show. Your real cost includes tuition, rent, food, insurance and travel, and living costs are often higher than the visa minimum in big cities.

BC overseas scholarship last date 31 Oct 2026 on ePASS. Ambedkar SC/ST and minority schemes: up to ₹20 lakh, 60% marks, income under ₹5 lakh.

### IELTS Exam Fee in India 2026: ₹19,000 | UKVI, Retake & Refund
URL: https://abbacy.in/ielts-exam-fee-in-india.html · Updated: 2026-10-23

IELTS exam fee in India 2026: ₹19,000. UKVI ₹19,250, One Skill Retake ₹12,650. Date-change charges, refund rules and how to avoid paying twice.

**Q: What is the IELTS exam fee in India in 2026?**
A: ₹19,000 for IELTS Academic and General Training, according to IDP IELTS India. IELTS for UKVI costs ₹19,250 and a One Skill Retake ₹12,650.

**Q: Is the IELTS fee the same in Hyderabad?**
A: Yes. The IELTS fee is the same in every Indian city.

**Q: Can I get a refund if I cancel my IELTS test?**
A: For IELTS on computer and writing on paper, cancelling 15 days or more before the test gets a refund after an administration fee of up to 25%. Within 14 days of the test, the fee is not refundable.

**Q: How much does it cost to reschedule IELTS?**
A: Moving your date is free up to 15 days before the test. Between 5 and 14 days before, a fee of up to 25% applies. Within 4 days, a transfer isn't allowed.

**Q: What is IELTS One Skill Retake and how much does it cost?**
A: It lets you retake one section, such as Writing, after a full IELTS test, instead of the whole test. It costs ₹12,650 in India.

**Q: How much is IELTS coaching at Abbacy?**
A: Our 4-week IELTS course costs ₹5,000, at our Himayatnagar centre or online. The IELTS exam fee is paid separately to IDP.

### UK Student Visa from India 2026: Fees, Funds & Steps
URL: https://abbacy.in/uk-student-visa-from-india.html · Updated: 2026-10-23

UK student visa from India 2026: £558 fee, £776 a year health surcharge, £1,529 or £1,171 monthly funds, documents, dependants and the Graduate visa.

**Q: How much is the UK student visa fee from India?**
A: £558 to apply from outside the UK, plus the Immigration Health Surcharge of £776 for each year of your visa.

**Q: How much bank balance is required for a UK student visa?**
A: Your unpaid first-year fees plus £1,529 a month in London or £1,171 a month elsewhere, for up to 9 months, held for at least 28 consecutive days.

**Q: Can I bring my wife on a UK student visa?**
A: Only if you are a government-sponsored student or a postgraduate on a PhD, other doctorate or research-based degree of 9 months or longer. Taught master's students can't bring dependants for courses starting from 1 January 2024.

**Q: How long does a UK student visa take from India?**
A: Applications from outside the UK usually get a decision within 3 weeks. Apply as early as 6 months before your course to leave room for delays.

**Q: How long is the UK Graduate visa?**
A: 2 years if you apply on or before 31 December 2026 (3 years after a PhD), and 18 months for bachelor's and master's graduates from 1 January 2027.

Duolingo English Test for Indian students: 1-hour online test, 10–160 scores, results in 2 days, 2-year validity, retake rules and a 2-week study plan.

A: Scores run from 10 to 160, with four subscores: Literacy, Comprehension, Conversation and Production.

**Q: How many times can I take the Duolingo English Test?**

Canada study permit from India in 2026: CAD 150 fee plus CAD 85 biometrics, CAD 23,448 funds from 1 Sept 2026, the PAL, documents, work rights and the PGWP.

**Q: What is the Canada student visa fee from India?**

**Q: How much bank balance is required for a Canada student visa?**

A: Most applicants do. Your institution usually helps you get the Provincial or Territorial Attestation Letter after you accept your offer. Some applicants are exempt; check IRCC's current list.

**Q: How many hours can I work in Canada as a student?**
A: Usually up to 24 hours a week off campus during academic sessions, and full-time during scheduled breaks.

**Q: How long is the PGWP after a master's in Canada?**
A: Up to 3 years, even if the master's is shorter than 2 years, provided you meet the PGWP conditions, including the language test.

Germany student visa from India 2026: APS certificate, €11,904 blocked account (€992 a month), the documents to submit and the 18-month job-search stay.

### Study in Germany for Free: Tuition-Free Universities 2026
URL: https://abbacy.in/study-in-germany-for-free.html · Updated: 2026-10-23

Can Indian students study in Germany for free? Most public universities charge no tuition, but expect a €70–430 semester fee, and two states differ.

**Q: Is education free in Germany for Indian students?**
A: At most public universities, yes: there is no tuition for bachelor's and most master's programmes. You pay a semester contribution of about €70 to €430 and your living costs.

**Q: Which German states charge tuition to Indian students?**
A: Baden-Württemberg charges non-EU students €1,500 per semester, and Bavarian universities may charge non-EU students several thousand euros per semester.

**Q: Is TU Munich free for Indian students?**
A: No. TU Munich is in Bavaria, where universities may charge non-EU students tuition. Check the fee on the programme page.

**Q: How much money do I need to study in Germany for free?**
A: Even with no tuition, you need the semester contribution, living costs of about €900 to €1,200 a month, and €11,904 in a blocked account for the visa.

**Q: Can I do a free master's in Germany in English?**
A: Yes. Many master's programmes at public universities are taught in English and charge no tuition, though popular programmes are competitive.

**Q: Can Abbacy shortlist tuition-free German universities for me?**
A: Yes. We shortlist public universities that match your marks and budget, and plan your APS and blocked account, free of charge.

UK scholarships for Indian students: Chevening (fully funded), Commonwealth Master's (£1,712–2,000 a month), GREAT and university awards, with dates.

UK Graduate visa for Indian students: £937 fee, £1,035 a year health surcharge, 2 years if you apply by 31 Dec 2026, then 18 months from 1 Jan 2027.

### PTE Exam Fee in India 2026: ₹18,900 & Refund Rules
URL: https://abbacy.in/pte-exam-fee-in-india.html · Updated: 2026-10-23

PTE exam fee in India for 2026: ₹18,900 for PTE Academic, PTE Core and PTE Academic UKVI, ₹15,300 for PTE Home, plus Pearson's reschedule and refund rules.

**Q: What is the PTE exam fee in India in 2026?**

**Q: Is the PTE fee refundable?**
A: Cancel more than 14 full days before for a full refund, 14 to 7 days before for a 50% refund, and there is no refund within 7 days.

**Q: Can I reschedule my PTE test for free?**

**Q: Which is cheaper in India, PTE or IELTS?**
A: PTE Academic costs ₹18,900 and IELTS Academic ₹19,000 in 2026, so they're almost the same.

APS certificate for Germany from India: who needs it, the online steps, courier-only documents, at least 2 weeks to process, and the new dMAT test.

**Q: Is APS mandatory for studying in Germany from India?**

**Q: Is the APS fee refundable?**

**Q: Can I submit APS documents in person?**
A: No. APS India accepts documents only by post or courier, as legible A4 colour photocopies.

**Q: Do I need to take the dMAT?**

### US Consulate Hyderabad: F-1 Visa Interview Day Guide (2026)

US Consulate Hyderabad for F-1 students: the Nanakramguda address, what you can't carry, the VAC step, social media rule and how to prepare for the interview.

**Q: What is the address of the US Consulate in Hyderabad?**
A: Survey No. 115/1, Financial District, Nanakramguda, Hyderabad, Telangana 500032, according to the U.S. Embassy & Consulates in India website.

**Q: Can I take my phone into the US Consulate in Hyderabad?**
A: No. Mobile phones and other electronic devices are not permitted, and the consulate has no facility to store them, so leave them with someone or at home.

**Q: Do F-1 students go to the VAC before the interview?**
A: Usually yes. The Visa Application Center appointment is for your photo and fingerprints, and the interview happens at the consulate. Use the VAC address on your appointment confirmation.

**Q: Do I need to make my Instagram public for an F-1 visa?**
A: Yes. The U.S. Embassy asks F, M and J visa applicants to set all social media accounts to public to allow identity vetting.
